Bilgisayar kullanımında otomatik onayı a: Toggle automatic approval for computer use
Demo modu; gerçek işlem yapılmaz: Demo mode; no real action is taken
Enter gönderir, Shift+Enter yeni satır: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line
Küçük, hep üstte duran hızlı komut pence: Opens the small quick-command window that stays on top; the command you type goes to the same chat.
Mesaj başına işlem kartlarını açar: Opens the action cards for each message
Modelin bağlamını sıfırlar; sonraki mesa: Resets the model's context; the next message starts with an empty history. It does not delete the permanent conversation archive. It does not reset while a run is active.
Onaylı: bilgisayar kullanımı, pencere ko: With approval: computer use, window control, and screen reading ask every time. Automatic: all three run without asking for approval (even in turns where external content was read); Esc stops them. Other tools are unaffected. Takes effect immediately.
Sesi aç veya kapat (yazma alanı): Turn voice on or off (input field)
Yeni bağlam açar; kalıcı konuşma arşivin: Opens a new context; does not delete the permanent conversation archive
